# One Hyde Park reconstruction review

The final `draft.json` is an editable `plan2world-draft-v1` semantic white model of Apartment B.07.1, Level 07, traced directly from the supplied 1086 × 1536 raster. It contains 110 wall segments, 35 ordinary door openings, 21 glazing openings and 164 independent semantic furniture/fixture blocks. It has no authored room polygons. The initial reconstruction is preserved in `first-pass.json`.

Scale is **estimated**, confidence 0.52. A visible ordinary Bedroom 4 ensuite doorway near source (437,839) spans approximately 22–23 pixels; assuming a nominal 90 cm doorway gives about 4 cm per pixel. Every object uses `cm = 4 × (sourcePixel − (250,80))`. The printed @A3 page ratio was not used as raster calibration. Six spread-out wall-endpoint anchors register the same transform; absolute dimensions still need a known building dimension.

The tapered external shell, diagonal bedroom partitions, bowed entrance-hall boundary and distinct reception/media/study/kitchen/service/suite areas were traced. Cabinets, low reception dividers, beds, rugs and swing arcs were distinguished from architectural walls. Rugs, planting, annotations, shared external stairs/lifts and balcony decks/railings were omitted. Windows have no explicit style, sill or height, so the white-model profile supplies floor-to-ceiling glass; this is a presentation assumption. Furniture is rectangular occupancy with assumed heights, leaving concrete styles editable.

I inspected the original image and enlarged north, middle and south crops, then examined source overlays of every drafted wall, opening and furniture footprint. This found the Bedroom 2 and 3 dressing/bath diagonal partitions too far outward in the first pass; their endpoints were corrected in the final draft. Two west second-reception chairs were separated from an initial single sofa block, and uncertain crossed utility fixtures were changed to `unknown` blocks. New T-junctions were split at shared coordinates. Numerical endpoint differences below 0.1 cm introduced three microscopic split artifacts during that correction; these were coalesced and removed. The intervening failed inspection is retained in `inspection/visual-revision/`.

The repository CLI `NODE_ENV=production node tooling/inspect-plan2world-draft.mjs` was run with the original source, width 1086, height 1536 and output confined to this reconstruction's inspection folder. Final result in `inspection/final/inspection.json`: parsing/conversion succeeded, registration accepted, **0 geometry errors, 1 warning**, and 23 automatically derived native regions. The warning concerns the detached media/study-WC/AV partition island, which is visibly separated from the facade by open circulation; I did not add an unsupported connector to suppress it. `inspection/additional-checks.json` records unique IDs, finite/positive dimensions, valid references and positions, no authored rooms, and six anchors with negligible numerical registration residual.

The scale, balcony door layout, facade mullion grouping, AV enclosure versus cabinetry, heights of reception dividers, dense service/ensuite swings, prep-kitchen access and principal dressing access remain uncertain. Tiny utility crossed rectangles have unknown identity. Rectangular piano, tubs, rounded tables and angled seating approximate occupancy. These checks establish structural validity and registration consistency; they **do not certify source-image accuracy**. No reference annotations, other candidates, external model/provider, browser walkthrough or application-code changes were used.
